shortBulletSummary: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index is at 38, signaling a state of fear in the market.
Bitcoin price has fallen below $80,000 due to profit-taking and substantial ETF outflows.
Bitcoin spot ETFs recorded $278 million in outflows, ending a period of consistent inflows.
Geopolitical uncertainty regarding US-Iran negotiations is contributing to a risk-off sentiment in crypto.
A Tether executive noted that the 2026 US midterm elections could significantly impact crypto regulations.
